brand.name: Prod2
brand.tagline: What to compare before you buy
brand.name_basis: Decision D-P03: keep the project's established name (Prod2) as the wordmark, per the carried D-18 rationale — no new trade name is introduced while name clearance (Q-19) is open. A consumer-facing rename is queued as suggestion SG-01.

disclosure_sentence: As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
disclosure_detail: Product links on this site are paid links (Amazon Associates Special Links). If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. We publish only figures read from official listings.
analytics_endpoint_note: Empty by default: the site sends nothing to any server until a self-hosted endpoint URL is set here and the site is rebuilt. Deployment of analytics-endpoint/server.py is tracked as flag F-19.

editorial.voice: Warm, direct, practical. Take a position inside verified facts; address the reader; never describe the checking process as the story (D-12).
editorial.evidence_rule: Every published figure resolves to a dated read of an official listing or an official policy page. Prices and star ratings are not published (F-02). Popularity claims only as dated snapshots of an official page (D-19).
